# RTX Remix SDK header (leftover)

This directory vendors a Remix C API header from an earlier experiment.
The game does **not** use it. The product path is Direct3D 12 with a Direct3D 9
fallback. `ARX_HAVE_RTX_REMIX` is not enabled.

Runtime binaries are not stored in Git.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Upstream repo | [NVIDIAGameWorks/dxvk-remix](https://github.com/NVIDIAGameWorks/dxvk-remix) |
| Header | `public/include/remix/remix_c.h` |
| Header license | MIT (banner at the top of `remix_c.h`) |
